items.title_en: What xAI's Grok Build CLI Actually Sends to xAI
items.title_zh: xAI 的 Grok Build CLI 实际向 xAI 发送了什么
items.summary_en: The Grok Build CLI's data flows are exposed, revealing what information is sent to the xAI service. The post flags potential privacy and data governance implications and suggests how to limit or audit what’s transmitted.
items.summary_zh: 揭示 Grok Build CLI 向 xAI 服务器发送的数据类型，引发隐私和数据治理方面的关注，并给出限制与审计的建议。

items.title_en: Mesh LLM: distributed AI computing on iroh
items.title_zh: Mesh LLM：在 iroh 上的分布式 AI 计算
items.summary_en: Mesh LLM demonstrates distributed AI computing across a mesh of nodes using iroh, reducing reliance on centralized hardware. The approach highlights how decentralized coordination can scale model inference and resilience in AI workloads.
items.summary_zh: Mesh LLM 展示了在 iroh 上通过网状节点进行分布式 AI 计算，降低对中心化硬件的依赖。去中心化协作在推理扩展和 AI 工作负载的弹性方面展现潜力。

items.title_en: Under federal rule, colleges must leave grads better off or lose financial aid
items.title_zh: 在联邦规定下，学校必须让毕业生的境况变好，否则可能失去联邦资助
items.summary_en: A federal rule requires colleges to demonstrate that their graduates fare better financially or risk loss of federal financial aid eligibility. The shift signals tighter accountability for higher education outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 联邦规定要求高校证明毕业生在经济上更有改善，否則将可能失去联邦资助资格。这一转变标志着对高校结果的更严格问责。

items.title_en: Show HN: Ant – A JavaScript runtime and ecosystem
items.title_zh: Show HN：Ant——一个 JavaScript 运行时与生态系统
items.summary_en: Ant introduces a new JavaScript runtime and its own ecosystem, offering a fresh option for running JS outside the browser. It emphasizes a streamlined, integrated toolchain that could influence server-side JavaScript workflows if it gains traction.
items.summary_zh: Ant 提供一个新的 JavaScript 运行时及其生态系统，为浏览器之外的 JS 提供新选项。若获得广泛采用，可能影响服务器端 JS 的工作流与工具链。

items.title_en: How Doctors die. It’s not like the rest of us (2016)
items.title_zh: 医生如何离世：与其他人不同（2016）
items.summary_en: An exploration of medical culture shows doctors' end-of-life decisions differ due to training, patient expectations, and clinical realities.
items.summary_zh: 文章揭示医学文化中医生的临终选择与受训、患者期望及临床现实相关的差异，强调医疗工作者关怀方面的不足及需要以同理心为导向的政策。

items.title_en: Unexpected Solidlike Fracture in Simple Liquids
items.title_zh: 简单液体的意外固态断裂
items.summary_en: Some simple liquids can fracture in a solid-like manner under certain conditions, challenging the conventional view that fluids always flow. The finding informs material science, phase transitions, and potential novel fluids with tunable fracture behavior.
items.summary_zh: 一些简单液体在特定条件下会呈现与流体不同的固态断裂行为，挑战了“流动就会流”的直觉。此发现有助于理解相变、材料科学，以及具可控断裂特性的新型流体。

items.title_en: Why Write Code in 2026
items.title_zh: 为什么在 2026 年写代码
items.summary_en: The piece argues that writing code remains essential in 2026, but expectations shift toward embracing AI copilots, higher-level tooling, and sustainable software practices. It emphasizes choosing problems that truly benefit from code and designing systems around maintainability.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为在 2026 年写代码依然重要，但趋势指向使用 AI 助手、提高抽象层级的工具以及可持续的软件实践。应选择真正需要编码的问题，并围绕可维护性来设计系统。

items.title_en: Prefer strict tables in SQLite
items.title_zh: 在 SQLite 中优先使用严格表
items.summary_en: Promotes using STRICT tables in SQLite to enforce data types and constraints, reducing silent data quality issues. Includes guidance on enabling strict tables and migrating schemas.
items.summary_zh: 倡导在 SQLite 中使用 STRICT 表以强制数据类型和约束，降低隐性数据质量问题。提供启用严格表和迁移模式的实用建议。

items.title_en: Female US rower completes historic solo journey from California to Hawaii
items.title_zh: 美籍女性单人划艇完成加州到夏威夷的历史性旅程
items.summary_en: Profiles a female rower completing a solo cross-ocean voyage; highlights endurance, training, and the growing visibility of women in extreme exploration.
items.summary_zh: 报道这位女性实现了单人横跨太平洋的纪录，展现极限耐力、训练与女性在极限探索领域的崭露头角。

items.title_en: A pure scheme web programming tool
items.title_zh: 一个纯 Scheme 的网页编程工具
items.summary_en: A minimal, pure Scheme toolchain for web development, avoiding other languages. It showcases how functional programming can handle frontend and backend tasks with a small, coherent toolset.
items.summary_zh: 一个纯 Scheme 的网页编程工具，尝试用最小的工具链完成前后端开发。强调函数式编程在网页开发中的表达力和简洁性。

items.title_en: Nvidia, CoreWeave, and Nebius: Inside the Circular Financing of the GPU Boom
items.title_zh: Nvidia、CoreWeave 与 Nebius：GPU 热潮的循环融资内幕
items.summary_en: Explains circular financing used by GPU-focused players to recycle capital across rounds, accelerating equipment deployment for AI workloads; discusses players' roles and financial tactics.
items.summary_zh: 揭示围绕 GPU 行业的循环融资如何在多轮融资中回流资本，加速 AI 工作负载的显卡部署。分析参与方的角色和财务策略。

items.title_en: RISCBoy is an open-source portable games console, designed from scratch
items.title_zh: RISCBoy：一个开源便携式游戏机，从零设计
items.summary_en: RISCBoy is an open-source, portable game console built from scratch, likely leveraging a RISC-V core. It showcases a DIY hardware ethos and offers a community-driven alternative to proprietary handhelds.
items.summary_zh: RISCBoy 是一个开源、便携的游戏机，完全从零设计，可能基于 RISC-V 架构。它体现了动手做硬件的精神，以及对专有掌上设备的社区驱动替代方案的探索。

items.title_en: Martha Lillard, last US polio patient using iron lung, dies at 78 in Oklahoma
items.title_zh: 美国最后一位使用铁肺的脊髓灰质炎患者在俄克拉荷马去世
items.summary_en: Martha Lillard, the last U.S. polio patient using an iron lung, dies at 78 in Oklahoma, marking the end of an era in medical history. The obituary reflects on polio, medical technology, and societal changes.
items.summary_zh: 美国最后一位使用铁肺的脊髓灰质炎患者玛莎·利拉德在俄克拉荷马州去世，享年78岁，标志着一个医疗历史时代的结束。对脊髓灰质炎、医疗技术及社会变迁的反思。

items.title_en: A dock that wakes up reliably
items.title_zh: 一个能可靠唤醒的扩展坞
items.summary_en: A USB-C/Thunderbolt dock that reliably wakes a host from sleep, addressing a common UX pain point. The write-up outlines hardware choices, wake signaling, and implications for laptop docking ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 一个扩展坞，能在休眠后可靠唤醒主机，解决常见的唤醒体验问题。文中讨论了硬件选择、唤醒信号及其对笔记本扩展生态的影响。

items.title_en: Show HN: Mindwalk – Replay coding-agent sessions on a 3D map of your codebase
items.title_zh: Show HN: Mindwalk——在代码库的3D地图上回放编码代理会话
items.summary_en: Mindwalk lets you replay coding-agent sessions on a 3D map of your codebase, helping you trace decisions and debugging. The visualization could accelerate understanding of model behavior across large repos and improve collaboration. This is especially useful for teams building AI-assisted coding tools.
items.summary_zh: Mindwalk 允许在代码库的三维地图上回放编码代理会话，帮助追踪决策与调试。可视化有助于理解大型代码库中模型行为，提升协作效率，尤其对开发 AI 辅助编码工具的团队有明显帮助。

items.title_en: Vinod Khosla to Buy Seattle Seahawks for $9.6B
items.title_zh: Vinod Khosla 将以 96 亿美元收购西雅图海鹰队
items.summary_en: Vinod Khosla is set to purchase the Seattle Seahawks for $9.6 billion, marking a tech-backed ownership transition in professional sports. The move could influence franchise strategy, sponsorships, and technology-driven fan engagement.
items.summary_zh: Vinod Khosla 将以 96 亿美元收购西雅图海鹰队，标志科技界投资者进入职业体育的所有权转变。此举可能影响球队治理、赞助与以科技驱动的球迷互动。

items.title_en: A Erlang style pure Scheme Webserver and further
items.title_zh: 一种 Erlang 风格的纯 Scheme Web 服务器及后续
items.summary_en: An Erlang-style pure Scheme web server demonstrates actor-like concurrency in a minimal Scheme environment, with follow-on improvements. It’s a playful take on merging concurrency models with a functional Lisp dialect.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一种 Erlang 风格的纯 Scheme Web 服务器，展示在纯 Scheme 环境中实现类似 actor 的并发，以及后续改进。

items.title_en: We scaled PgBouncer to 4x throughput
items.title_zh: PgBouncer 吞吐量提升四倍
items.summary_en: Shows how to push PgBouncer-based connection pooling to four times the throughput for PostgreSQL workloads, with practical tuning tips and pooling-mode considerations. Demonstrates integration with a managed Postgres stack to reduce connection overhead and latency.
items.summary_zh: 展示如何将 PgBouncer 基于连接池的吞吐量提升至四倍，给出实际的参数调整和池模式选择要点。展示在 ClickHouse 管理的 Postgres 场景中降低连接开销、提升延迟表现的做法。

items.title_en: UPI: Anatomy of a Payment Transaction
items.title_zh: UPI：支付交易的解剖结构
items.summary_en: Outlines how UPI payments flow from payer to merchant, detailing routing, settlement, and security checks; implications for throughput, fee structures, and interoperability.
items.summary_zh: 解析 UPI 支付的完整交易流程，包括路由、结算与安全校验，揭示其对吞吐量、费用和互操作性的影响。

items.title_en: QuadRF can spot drones and see WiFi through my wall
items.title_zh: QuadRF 能侦测无人机并穿墙探测 WiFi 信号
items.summary_en: QuadRF demonstrates that RF sensing can reveal both drone activity and WiFi signals through walls. This kind of passive observation highlights security and privacy implications for home networks and aerial devices, even when devices aren't in visible sight. It also underscores practical limits like range, clutter, and legal boundaries.
items.summary_zh: QuadRF 展示了射频探测可以在墙后揭示无人机活动和 WiFi 信号。这类被动观测引发对家庭网络和无人机安全与隐私的担忧，同时也暴露出覆盖范围、信号干扰和法律边界等局限。

items.title_en: Show HN: Learn by rebuilding Redis, Git, a database from scratch
items.title_zh: Show HN: 通过从头重建 Redis、Git 与数据库来学习
items.summary_en: A learning-by-rebuilding project; shares experiments and code for reconstructing core systems, offering practical insights into data structures and OS concepts.
items.summary_zh: 一个以重建核心组件来学习的练习项目，包含 Redis、Git、数据库等实现的代码与笔记，帮助理解底层数据结构与系统设计。

items.title_en: Fixed three bugs that made Qwen3.5-122B a daily driver on Mac Studio
items.title_zh: 修复三个错误，使 Qwen3.5-122B 成为 Mac Studio 的日常驱动
items.summary_en: Three bugs were fixed to stabilize Qwen3.5-122B on Mac Studio, turning it into a reliable daily driver for local AI workloads. The updates address stability and compatibility issues that previously hindered performance on Apple Silicon.
items.summary_zh: 修复了三个错误，使 Qwen3.5-122B 在 Mac Studio 上成为稳定的日常使用对象。更新提升了稳定性和与 Apple Silicon 的兼容性，使本地 AI 使用更可靠。

items.title_en: The early History of the Singular Value Decomposition (1993) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 奇异值分解的早期历史（1993）
items.summary_en: Tracing the origins of the singular value decomposition and its early formulations, showing how the idea underpins modern data compression, PCA, and machine learning. The PDF offers historical context for a fundamental tool in linear algebra.
items.summary_zh: 追溯奇异值分解的早期发展及其在现代数据分析中的影响，展示该工具在降维、数据压缩和机器学习中的核心作用的历史背景。

items.title_en: ZeroFS vs. Amazon S3 Files
items.title_zh: ZeroFS 与 Amazon S3 文件系统的对比
items.summary_en: ZeroFS contrasts its filesystem approach with Amazon S3's object storage, discussing trade-offs in semantics, performance, and usability.
items.summary_zh: ZeroFS 与 Amazon S3 的文件模型对比，讨论语义、性能与易用性等权衡。文章强调在某些用例中，ZeroFS 提供更接近本地文件系统的语义和更顺畅的开发体验。

items.title_en: Autopsy Study Finds Replicating SARS-CoV-2 in the Hearts of Long Covid
items.title_zh: 尸检研究发现长年新冠患者心脏中存在 SARS‑CoV‑2
items.summary_en: An autopsy study finds SARS-CoV-2 replication in the hearts of some long-COVID patients, shedding light on cardiac involvement and potential mechanisms behind lingering symptoms. The result underscores long-COVID's potential organ-specific effects and the need for ongoing cardiovascular monitoring.
items.summary_zh: 尸检研究发现部分长期新冠患者的心脏中存在 SARS‑CoV‑2 的复制，揭示心脏受累及长期症状的潜在机制。结果强调长期新冠对心血管健康的潜在影响，需持续监测。

items.title_en: 6× faster binary search: from compiled code to mechanical sympathy
items.title_zh: 六倍更快的二分搜索：从编译代码到对硬件的理解
items.summary_en: A set of optimizations—branchless code, vectorization, and architecture-aware tricks—achieve roughly sixfold speedups for binary search, illustrating how hardware-aware micro-optimizations can materially affect logarithmic-time algorithms.
items.summary_zh: 通过分支最小化、向量化及与体系结构相关的技巧，二分查找实现约六倍加速，展示了基于硬件的微观优化如何显著提升对数时间算法的性能。

items.title_en: Show HN: Orbit – AR satellite tracker, watch 15k+ objects
items.title_zh: Show HN: Orbit – AR 卫星追踪器，监视 15k+ 颗对象
items.summary_en: Presents Orbit, an AR satellite tracker that visualizes 15k+ objects in real time; demonstrates how AR can augment space awareness and educate users.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Orbit，这款 AR 卫星追踪器可在现实世界中实时可视 15k+ 颗对象，展示了 AR 在提升空间认知方面的潜力。

items.title_en: The Energetic Costs of Cellular Computation (2012)
items.title_zh: 细胞计算的能量成本（2012）
items.summary_en: An early 2012 study quantifies the energy budget of cellular information processing, framing computing in biological systems in terms of metabolic costs per bit. The work foreshadows energy-aware design for bio-computing and helps benchmarks energy efficiency in neuromorphic ideas.
items.summary_zh: 这篇 2012 年的研究量化了细胞信息处理的能量预算，将代谢成本与每比特的能耗联系起来。工作为生物计算的能效设计提供基准，并为类脑计算的能耗研究奠定基础。

items.title_en: Show HN: Getting GLM 5.2 running on my slow computer
items.title_zh: Show HN：在慢速电脑上让 GLM 5.2 运行起来
items.summary_en: A developer documents getting GLM 5.2 to run on a slow machine, sharing practical steps, constraints, and tweaks. It shows how lightweight inference paths and community tooling can unlock usable performance on modest hardware.
items.summary_zh: 开发者记录在慢速计算机上运行 GLM 5.2 的过程，提供具体步骤、限制与调整方法。展示了通过轻量化推理路径和社区工具在中等硬件上也能获得可用性能的可能。

items.title_en: Show HN: Reame – a CPU inference server that gets faster as it runs
items.title_zh: Show HN: Reame – 一个运行时越跑越快的 CPU 推理服务器
items.summary_en: Showcases Reame, a CPU inference server whose performance improves as it runs, likely through caching or adaptive optimizations; discusses practical ML inference on CPU.
items.summary_zh: 展示 Reame，这个 CPU 推理服务器随着运行时间提升性能，可能通过缓存与自适应优化实现；讨论在 CPU 上进行高效推理的实用性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Sqlsure – deterministic semantic checks for AI-generated SQL
items.title_zh: Show HN: Sqlsure——用于 AI 生成 SQL 的确定性语义检查
items.summary_en: Sqlsure provides deterministic semantic checks for AI-generated SQL, helping ensure queries preserve semantics and safety across deterministic inputs. It supports reproducible testing and auditing of AI-produced SQL.
items.summary_zh: Sqlsure 提供对 AI 生成 SQL 的确定性语义检查，帮助确保查询在语义与安全性方面的一致性。支持对 AI 产出 SQL 进行可重复的测试与审计。

items.title_en: Show HN: Earth Game – An offline CLI for turning life goals into quests
items.title_zh: Show HN: Earth Game – 将生活目标转化为任务的离线 CLI
items.summary_en: Introduces Earth Game, an offline CLI that translates life goals into quests, enabling lightweight gamification without online dependencies.
items.summary_zh: 展示 Earth Game，这款离线命令行工具把生活目标转化成任务/挑战，适合在没有网络的情况下进行自我驱动的游戏化管理。

items.title_en: G#: A modern .NET language with Go, Kotlin, and Swift ergonomics
items.title_zh: G#: 一种具有 Go、Kotlin、Swift 风格的现代 .NET 语言
items.summary_en: G# is a modern .NET language blending ergonomic syntax inspired by Go, Kotlin, and Swift, aiming to improve productivity on the .NET platform. The project highlights ongoing language innovation in the .NET ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: G# 是一门现代的 .NET 语言，语法风格受 Go、Kotlin、Swift 启发，旨在提升 .NET 平台的开发效率。该项目体现了 .NET 语言生态的持续创新。

items.title_en: I built TradingSpy: local, privacy-first AI trading assistant(First Open Source)
items.title_zh: TradingSpy：本地、隐私优先的 AI 交易助手（首个开源实现）
items.summary_en: TradingSpy is a local, privacy-first AI trading assistant; its first open-source release emphasizes running AI agents on-device with no cloud data leakage. It aims to empower traders with customizable, transparent AI tooling.
items.summary_zh: TradingSpy 是一个本地、隐私优先的 AI 交易助手，首次开源强调在本地运行 AI 助手，避免云端数据泄露。目标是为交易者提供可定制、透明的 AI 工具。

items.title_en: Using PowerShell over SSH, Twenty Years Later
items.title_zh: 二十年前推出 PowerShell over SSH 的今天，文章回顾了远程自动化在跨平台环境中的成熟度、性能与演进工具
items.summary_en: Two decades after introducing PowerShell over SSH, the post reflects on maturity, performance, and evolving tooling for remote automation on diverse platforms. It provides insights for building cross-platform automation stacks.
items.summary_zh: 在推出 PowerShell over SSH 二十年后，文章回顾了跨平台环境中远程自动化的成熟度、性能和工具演进，为构建跨平台自动化栈提供见解。

items.title_en: Book: RISC-V System-on-Chip Design
items.title_zh: RISC-V 系统芯片设计（书籍）
items.summary_en: This book surveys how to design Systems-on-Chip around the RISC-V ISA, covering architecture, verification, toolchains, and ecosystem considerations. It helps engineers reason about open ISA advantages and practical design trade-offs for modern SoCs.
items.summary_zh: 本书系统介绍在 RISC-V 指令集上的系统芯片设计，包括架构、验证、工具链与生态等方面，帮助工程师理解开源 ISA 在现代硬件设计中的应用与取舍。

items.title_en: Billions of Sketches Reveal Hidden Cultural Variation in Human Concepts
items.title_zh: 数十亿幅素描揭示人类概念的隐藏文化差异
items.summary_en: Researchers analyze billions of sketches to show that concept representations vary across cultures, challenging universal assumptions in AI and cognitive science. The findings imply that AI systems trained on a single cultural dataset may misinterpret concepts in diverse user groups.
items.summary_zh: 研究者对数十亿幅素描进行分析，揭示人类概念在不同文化中存在显著差异，质疑AI与认知科学中的普遍性假设。结果意味着以单一文化数据集训练的AI系统在不同群体中的概念理解可能存在偏差。

items.title_en: An agent in 100 lines of Lisp
items.title_zh: 用 100 行 Lisp 实现的智能体
items.summary_en: A compact Lisp-based agent implemented in about 100 lines, illustrating how a small interpreter and simple loops can drive goal-oriented behavior. It highlights Lisp’s expressiveness for quick AI experiments.
items.summary_zh: 用约 100 行 Lisp 实现的智能体，展示了一个小型解释器和简单循环如何驱动目标导向的行为，凸显 Lisp 在快速 AI 实验中的表达力。

items.title_en: Biff.graph: structure your Clojure codebase as a queryable graph
items.title_zh: Biff.graph：将 Clojure 代码库结构化为可查询的图
items.summary_en: Biff.graph lets you model a Clojure codebase as a graph that can be queried, enabling structural analysis and refactoring insights. It helps developers inspect dependencies, call graphs, and relationships across namespaces.
items.summary_zh: Biff.graph 允许把 Clojure 代码库建模为一个可查询的图谱，便于进行结构分析和重构洞察。它帮助开发者查看依赖关系、调用图以及各命名空间之间的关系。

items.title_en: Otary – Image and Geometry Python Library Now Has Tutorials
items.title_zh: Otary：图像与几何 Python 库现已提供教程
items.summary_en: Otary's image and geometry library just released tutorials that walk users through installation, basic workflows, and typical use cases. The materials lower the barrier to experimenting with advanced image-processing and geometric computations in Python.
items.summary_zh: Otary 的图像与几何处理库推出教程，涵盖安装、入门和常见工作流，降低学习门槛。有助于科研和教学中使用该库进行图像与几何计算。

items.title_en: I Did Not Kill Stanley Lieber: How to Draw (With 9front)
items.title_zh: 我没有杀死斯坦利·李：用 9front 绘画
items.summary_en: A quirky exploration of drawing with 9front, a Plan 9-inspired OS, through a Stanley Lieber reference. The piece uses retro tooling to show how constraints can inspire creative programming experiments.
items.summary_zh: 以 9front 为背景的绘画实验，借用斯坦利·李的名字制造幽默参照，展示用 Plan 9 式系统进行图形创作的乐趣。通过受限工具链，体现了约束也能激发创作。

items.title_en: Digital Deli, 1984 book by early PC hackers and enthusiasts
items.title_zh: Digital Deli：1984 年的早期 PC 黑客与爱好者
items.summary_en: Represents a snapshot of 1980s PC culture, revealing DIY hacking ethos, toolsets, and community norms that shaped personal computing.
items.summary_zh: 记录 1984 年代早期 PC 黑客与爱好者的文化风貌、工具与社区规范，揭示个人计算的发展脉络。

items.title_en: Vint Cerf will step down from his role at Google next week
items.title_zh: Vint Cerf 将于下周从 Google 辞任
items.summary_en: Vint Cerf, a pioneering Internet architect, will step down from his Google role next week after years shaping policy and public engagement. His leadership helped advance core Internet protocols and interoperability, and his exit marks a notable shift in Google's external-innovation posture.
items.summary_zh: 互联网奠基人 Vint Cerf 将于下周从 Google 辞任，长期在政策与公共参与方面发挥影响力。他推动了核心互联网协议与互操作性的发展，其离任标志 Google 对外部创新战略的显著变化。

items.title_en: Amber the programming language compiled to Bash/Ksh/Zsh
items.title_zh: Amber：编译成 Bash/Ksh/Zsh 的编程语言
items.summary_en: Describes a language that compiles to shell scripts, enabling rapid automation and scripting; discusses trade-offs like portability and readability.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一种可编译为 Bash/Ksh/Zsh 脚本的编程语言，强调在自动化与快速原型中的应用，同时也讨论可移植性和可读性等权衡。

items.title_en: Optimization Solver as a Service
items.title_zh: 将优化求解器作为服务
items.summary_en: QuicOpt offers optimization solvers as a service, simplifying integration of combinatorial optimization in apps via a hosted API. This lowers operational friction for teams needing fast, scalable solver capabilities.
items.summary_zh: QuicOpt 提供将优化求解器作为服务，通过托管 API 将组合优化问题接入应用。降低了开发团队对自建求解器的运维门槛，并提升可伸缩性。

items.title_en: Jellyfish Undersea Roundabout
items.title_zh: 海底水母环形路口
items.summary_en: Faroe Islands unveils the world's first undersea roundabout dubbed Jellyfish, a novel underwater traffic junction linking island routes. The project showcases ambitious civil engineering and interdisciplinary design challenges in extreme environments.
items.summary_zh: 法罗群岛推出全球首个海底环形路口，名为 Jellyfish，作为新型水下交通交汇点。该项目展示了在极端环境下的工程与跨学科设计挑战。

items.title_en: Text art tools
items.title_zh: 文本艺术工具
items.summary_en: A curated collection of text-art tools for ASCII art, diagrams, and stylized headers; enhances docs and READMEs with lightweight visuals without images.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个收集文本艺术工具的集合，涵盖 ASCII 艺术、图表和风格化标题等。为文档和 README 提供轻量化的可视化效果，无需图片即可美化内容。

items.title_en: EF Core 11 makes your split queries faster
items.title_zh: EF Core 11 提升拆分查询速度
items.summary_en: EF Core 11 accelerates split queries, reducing the overhead of separate database trips for related data. Large-scale apps with complex includes can see lower latency and improved throughput.
items.summary_zh: EF Core 11 对拆分查询进行了优化，降低了对相关数据分多次查询的开销。处理大型、复杂包含的应用时，可能实现更低延迟和更高吞吐。

items.title_en: Protobuf-py: Protobuf for Python, without compromises
items.title_zh: Protobuf-py：Python 版 Protobuf，毫不妥协
items.summary_en: Protobuf-py provides a Python-native Protobuf runtime with minimal compromises, ensuring seamless cross-language data interchange and performance. It enables efficient wire-format handling and smoother integration with services across languages.
items.summary_zh: Protobuf-py 提供了一个 Python 原生的 Protobuf 运行时，强调兼容性和性能，避免妥协。它使跨语言的数据序列化/反序列化更加高效，便于与其他语言的服务对接。
